Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Manager of the Partnerships Applied AI Solutions Architect team, you will drive adoption of frontier AI by enabling deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, API) through our Global and Regional System Integrators, cloud partners (AWS, GCP, Azure), and strategic technology partners.

You will build and lead a team of Partner Solutions Architects, establish processes and best practices for partner-led pre-sales engagements, and represent Anthropic as the technical lead on its most important partnerships. In collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering, you will help partners incorporate leading-edge AI into their practices, accelerate indirect revenue, and execute long-term GTM strategy while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.

Responsibilities

    Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and mentor a team of Partner Solutions Architects. Set goals, run reviews, and coach each team member toward high productivity and career growth.
    Strategic Technical Partnership: Act as the senior technical thought partner to Anthropic's GTM partnerships team. Co-build partner strategy with aligned GTM leadership, drive key programs, and align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Engineering) behind partner outcomes.
    Partner Enablement & Ecosystem: Embed your team with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, troubleshoot, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. Represent Anthropic at partner events (GSI workshops, AWS/GCP summits, hackathons) and contribute technical content and thought leadership.
    Joint Solution Development: Lead partners in identifying high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications. Develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures and best practices to accelerate time to deployment.
    Customer Deal Support: Own the technical portion of partner-led pre-sales engagements. Intervene directly on strategic deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep solution architecture guidance.
    Product Feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products from partner deployments and deliver it to Product and Engineering to inform roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

    7+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner SE, TAM).
    3+ years managing pre-sales or partner-facing technical teams; comfortable building foundational teams in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
    Track record building and scaling partnerships with GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys) and/or cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).
    Deep understanding of partner-led selling and delivery: indirect revenue models, enablement at scale, and joint GTM motions.
    Technical depth in enterprise AI deployments: LLM architecture, prompt engineering, evaluation, API integrations, and production use cases.
    Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to build trusted relationships with C-suite, partner leadership, and engineering teams alike.
    A love of teaching and mentoring, and a passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI.

Strong candidates may also have

    5+ years leading partner-facing SA teams through hypergrowth, including developing both senior and junior talent.
    Direct experience helping GSIs or consultancies build their AI/ML practice - enablement programs, certification paths, joint solution development.

Compensation

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary: $315,000 - $380,000 USD

# Anthropic - Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships briefing packet
| Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships | $315,000-$380,000 OTE | Reports to Partnerships (partner GTM context) |

## JD Complement
Anthropic’s public identity joins frontier AI development with an explicit emphasis on reliability, interpretability, and steerability. The commercial implication is clear: enterprise growth must retain technical rigor and responsible-use
standards as Claude reaches more customers through external delivery channels.

The central challenge is not partner coverage alone. It is building repeatable implementation capacity across an ecosystem while maintaining coherent architecture guidance, customer expectations, and feedback paths into internal teams.
The strongest operating model will turn lessons from high-stakes engagements into reusable assets rather than leaving them trapped in individual accounts.

This is therefore a scale-and-quality leadership mandate. It calls for someone who can develop a technical organization, establish practical operating mechanisms, and make partner-delivered work feel consistent with Anthropic’s product
and safety posture.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Anthropic is an AI safety and research company building Claude for business users, developers, and organizations with demanding security and governance requirements. Its public-benefit orientation reinforces a culture in which
commercial execution and responsible deployment must remain connected.

Its enterprise motion has several notable characteristics:
- Claude addresses both knowledge-work use cases and developer-led application building.
- Product quality, security, and reliability are part of the commercial value proposition.

The company must grow beyond a small number of centrally supported deployments without becoming dependent on bespoke services work. This makes partner technical maturity, consistent solution patterns, and clear escalation design
important strategic levers.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Anthropic operates in a rapidly changing market where enterprises can select from foundation-model providers, cloud platforms, packaged AI products, and internally built tooling. Competitive advantage depends not only on model
capability, but also on whether customers can apply that capability securely and repeatedly in real workflows.

Claude’s business offering spans security, compliance, employee-facing use cases, and developer needs. That creates a broad set of stakeholders within a customer: technology leaders, security teams, business sponsors, developers,
procurement, and transformation owners. Partner teams need to navigate these groups without fragmenting the technical narrative.

A likely internal tension is speed versus governed reuse. Local teams and partners may need flexibility to respond to industry and account-specific conditions. At the same time, Anthropic needs standard approaches that preserve quality,
reduce reinvention, and reveal which recurring needs warrant product investment.

The practical question is how to make joint work scalable: identify where configurable patterns suffice, where expert intervention is essential, and when a repeated issue should become an enablement asset, platform improvement, or
formal delivery guidance.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
The role sits at the intersection of ecosystem strategy, technical adoption, and product learning. Its success will require credibility with commercial leaders and technical practitioners alike, plus the ability to create productive
shared accountability across groups with different priorities.

Likely stakeholder groups include:
- Customer success and adoption teams, focused on sustained value after initial rollout.

The leader’s influence will depend on creating a common operating language: which partner capabilities matter, what “ready” means, how technical risk is surfaced, and how field observations are prioritized without overwhelming
internal teams.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Claude is presented as an AI assistant for analysis, writing, coding, and complex problem solving, with an emphasis on safety, accuracy, and security. This creates an architecture environment that spans end-user access, application
development, identity, governance, workflow design, evaluation, and operational improvement.

Anthropic’s enterprise-administration material frames rollout as a multi-stage journey, beginning with foundational configuration and continuing through organizational launch, adoption, and optimization. That framing is important:
technical implementation is necessary but insufficient. Customers also need usable operating practices, change support, and a path for refining outcomes over time.

Key architecture implications include:
- Partners need teachable designs that can be adapted without losing core quality principles.

The highest-value technical leadership contribution is likely a portfolio of referenceable approaches: patterns that are credible to architects, practical for partner practitioners, and understandable to customer decision-makers.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Anthropic publicly presents an ecosystem spanning cloud, technology, and services organizations. That structure suggests partners are a meaningful route to enterprise adoption, not a peripheral referral mechanism.

A mature ecosystem motion requires connected capabilities:
- Joint offers that translate Claude capabilities into concrete business and industry scenarios.
- Partner learning programs that build both technical judgment and customer-facing confidence.

System integrators can be major multipliers because they bring client relationships, industry context, transformation programs, and practitioner capacity. The opportunity is substantial, but scale can also magnify inconsistency.
Poorly prepared partners can create fragmented designs, unclear customer expectations, and avoidable pressure on central technical teams.

The operating objective should be ecosystem leverage with controlled quality: broad enough to reach enterprise demand, disciplined enough to retain a recognizable Anthropic standard.

## Recent Events & Urgency
Anthropic’s visible partner activity indicates that ecosystem development is increasingly important to enterprise reach. Its network includes cloud, technology, and services participants, while public partner materials emphasize
solving difficult customer AI challenges through coordinated capabilities.

Recent announcements involving major financial sponsors and AI-services relationships further suggest that services capacity is becoming a strategic distribution lever. As more organizations build advisory and implementation
offerings around Claude, the need for consistent technical readiness becomes more immediate.

This raises several near-term questions:
- Which partner profiles should receive the deepest technical investment?
- What minimum architecture and delivery standards support customer confidence?
- How should high-value partner opportunities gain access to specialized expertise?
- How can partner practitioners be productive without creating central-team dependency?

Urgency comes from the compound effect of growth: every strong reusable pattern can improve many downstream engagements, while every unresolved inconsistency can spread across an expanding ecosystem.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Creating feedback systems that elevate recurring patterns over isolated field requests.

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Claude’s enterprise rollout model points to a need for partner guidance beyond initial configuration.

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims, outcomes, scope, leadership experience, technical depth, and partnership results must come from the governed resume/proof graph.
